text: SELECT metabolism.met_id, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, metabolism.enzyme_name, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS substrate_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS substrate_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_name FROM metabolism JOIN compound_records ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE metabolism.tax_id = 9615 ORDER BY metabolism.met_id ASC LIMIT 200
